The Ultimate Des Moines Patio Guide: 20 Must-Try Outdoor Dining Spots for 2024

When the Iowa weather cooperates, there's nothing better than dining al fresco in Des Moines. From rooftop bars with skyline views to hidden garden patios, the capital city's outdoor dining scene has exploded in recent years. We've curated the definitive guide to the best patio dining experiences across the metro area.

Downtown Des Moines Rooftop & Patio Gems

East Village Favorites

  • Alba Restaurant - Intimate courtyard setting surrounded by brick walls and twinkling lights. Perfect for date night.
  • Up-Down - Expansive rooftop arcade bar offering skyline views and retro gaming.
  • The Republic on Grand - Sleek rooftop lounge atop the AC Hotel with stunning Capitol views.

Court Avenue District Hot Spots

  • Juniper Moon - Secret garden-style patio with craft cocktails and small plates.
  • Court Avenue Restaurant & Brewing Co. - Sprawling street-side patio perfect for people watching.
  • RoCA - Intimate back patio with fire features and creative tapas menu.

West Side Patio Paradise

Ingersoll Avenue Gems

  • Eatery A - Mediterranean-inspired covered patio with hanging plants and heaters.
  • Star Bar - Local favorite with casual vibe and excellent burger menu.
  • Harbinger - Intimate side patio featuring award-winning farm-to-table cuisine.

Seasonal Patio Events & Specials

Summer Highlights

Many venues offer special programming during peak patio season (May-September), including:

  • Live music brunches
  • Outdoor yoga + mimosas
  • Farm-to-table dinners
  • Iowa State Fair special menus
